authority.domain_profile: MC-A accepted current tranche: conventional lathe plus fixed-axis three-axis mill with explicit setup transitions
authority.sweep_semantics: S = closure(union over engaged source parameter/time of translated finite effective cutting solid)
authority.orientation_error_in_this_task: exactly zero inside one milling operation; reorientation belongs to an explicit later setup transition

cutter.local_set: for 0<=z<=R use rho^2+(z-R)^2<=R^2; for R<=z<=L use rho^2<=R^2
cutter.relation_to_mc018: this is the c=R ball/round limit that MC-018 explicitly excluded; MC-019 implements it directly rather than extrapolating the MC-018 c<R formula

exact_construction.representation: finite ordered exact-rational line leaves bound to closed engaged source intervals
exact_construction.lower_nose_algorithm: intersect source parameter with local 0<=z<=R, then minimize exact quadratic 3-D squared distance to the translated sphere-centre line p(t)+(0,0,R)
exact_construction.upper_algorithm: intersect source parameter with local R<=z<=L, then minimize exact quadratic XY distance to the translated axis line

mc058_leaf_construction.input_requirement: each finite derived line leaf remains bound to its exact source interval and carries a certified Euclidean translation enclosure e from MC-058; time/path/phase correlation and semantic boundaries remain bound
mc058_leaf_construction.fixed_axis_requirement: orientation is unchanged within MC-019, so the MC-058 rho*e_rotation term is zero here rather than silently discarded for a rotating cutter
mc058_leaf_construction.outer_rule: the complete ball/round cutter is contained in radius R, axial [0,L]; with translation error e the true sweep is contained in union of segment cylinders radius R+e and axial [-e,L+e]
mc058_leaf_construction.inner_rule: the exact cutter contains the central cylinder radius R/2 on axial [R/2,L]; eroding that cylinder by e yields radius R/2-e and axial [R/2+e,L-e], when nonempty, as a certified subset of the true sweep

simultaneous_xyz_f03_style.identity: at t=1/2 the sphere-centre residual (-2/3,1/3,-2/3) has squared norm 1 and is perpendicular to motion (2,0,-2), so this is a true lower-nose tangent rather than a seam endpoint
